description: Prepares a budget version for a fiscal year as a DRAFT: from last year's actuals, from another budget (list_budgets), or empty, optionally changed by a percentage. It is never made the year's active budget here: tell the user it is waiting for them in Mobile Accounting, where they review it and make it active. The user must be allowed to keep the books' budgets.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year (named by the year it ends in); default the current one.

name.description: A name for the version, up to 60 characters (default: Budget).

percentChange.description: A change to apply, in percent: 5 = 5% more, -10 = 10% less.

sourceBudgetId.description: With copy-budget: the budget to copy, from list_budgets.

name: draft_budget
title: Draft a budget
